figurative_meaning_en: The night following the consummation of marriage in a Hindu household
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের বিয়ের পর কালরাত্রি অবিস্মরণীয় হয়ে উঠল।
প্রথাগতভাবে হিন্দু পরিবারে কালরাত্রি বিশেষ গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
example_sentences_in_english: Their kalratri after the wedding turned out to be unforgettable.
Traditionally, in Hindu families, kalratri holds special importance.
history: This term originates from Hindu wedding customs in Bengali culture, referring to the first intimate night after the marriage ceremony, symbolizing the beginning of conjugal life.
note: The term carries cultural sensitivity related to marital intimacy in traditional Hindu Bengali society.
